While the LED television and home appliance business are catered to by DTIL, mobile phones and IT hardware manufacturing come under its wholly-owned subsidiary, Padget Electronics Private Limited (PEPL).
Similarly, the refrigerator business is undertaken through its wholly-owned subsidiary - Dixon Electro Manufacturing Private Limited.
